packs.name: Current
packs.description: From passive parts to power-control ICs.

packs.name: Superposition
packs.description: Single- and multi-qubit gates, plus readout.

packs.name: Membrane
packs.description: Ion channels and pumps in biological circuits.

packs.name: Signal Cascade
packs.description: Receptors and switches that relay signals.

cards.name: Resistor
cards.description: Limits current and sets voltage drops.

cards.name: Capacitor
cards.description: Stores energy in an electric field.

cards.name: Inductor
cards.description: Stores energy in a magnetic field.

cards.name: Signal Diode
cards.description: Conducts mainly in one direction.

cards.name: LED
cards.description: Emits light when forward-biased.

cards.name: Zener Diode
cards.description: Holds a reference voltage in reverse breakdown.

cards.name: BJT
cards.description: Uses base current to control collector current.

cards.name: MOSFET
cards.description: Uses a gate voltage to switch or regulate current.

cards.name: Crystal Oscillator
cards.description: Generates a stable clock signal using quartz.

cards.name: Operational Amplifier
cards.description: Amplifies the voltage difference between its inputs.

cards.name: Instrumentation Amp
cards.description: Amplifies small differential signals while rejecting shared noise.

cards.name: Switching Regulator
cards.description: Converts voltage efficiently with a rapidly switched power stage.

cards.name: Pauli X
cards.description: Flips the computational basis states.

cards.name: Pauli Y
cards.description: Flips the basis states and changes their phases.

cards.name: Pauli Z
cards.description: Adds a minus sign to the |1⟩ amplitude.

cards.name: Hadamard
cards.description: Maps the computational basis to equal superpositions.

cards.name: Phase Gate
cards.description: Adds a quarter turn of phase to the |1⟩ amplitude.

cards.name: Z Measurement
cards.description: Returns a classical bit from a computational-basis measurement.

cards.name: T Gate
cards.description: Adds a phase of π/4 to the |1⟩ amplitude.

cards.name: CNOT
cards.description: Flips a target qubit when the control is |1⟩.

cards.name: Controlled Z
cards.description: Adds a minus sign to the |11⟩ amplitude.

cards.name: SWAP
cards.description: Exchanges the states of two qubits.

cards.name: Toffoli
cards.description: Flips its target if both control qubits are |1⟩.

cards.name: Fredkin
cards.description: Swaps two target qubits when the control is |1⟩.

cards.name: Kir2.1
cards.description: An inward-rectifier potassium channel that helps stabilize membrane voltage.

cards.name: TASK-1
cards.description: Provides a potassium leak current sensitive to extracellular pH.

cards.name: ClC-1
cards.description: Provides chloride conductance in skeletal muscle.

cards.name: Nav1.4
cards.description: Carries voltage-gated sodium current in skeletal muscle.

cards.name: Kv1.2
cards.description: Carries outward potassium current when activated by voltage.

cards.name: Cav1.2
cards.description: Carries calcium into cells in response to depolarization.

cards.name: HCN4
cards.description: Opens on hyperpolarization and contributes to pacemaker activity.

cards.name: Na⁺/K⁺ ATPase
cards.description: Uses ATP to move sodium out and potassium in.

cards.name: SERCA2
cards.description: Uses ATP to move calcium into the endoplasmic or sarcoplasmic reticulum.

cards.name: Piezo1
cards.description: Converts membrane tension into an ion current.

cards.name: Ryanodine Receptor 2
cards.description: Releases stored calcium during cardiac contraction.

cards.name: Connexin 43
cards.description: Forms gap junctions that couple adjacent cells electrically.

cards.name: Calmodulin
cards.description: Changes shape when it binds calcium and regulates downstream targets.

cards.name: Synaptotagmin 1
cards.description: Senses calcium to help trigger rapid neurotransmitter release.

cards.name: Gαs
cards.description: Stimulates adenylyl cyclase after activation by a receptor.

cards.name: Adenylyl Cyclase 5
cards.description: Produces cAMP in response to upstream signals.

cards.name: Phosphodiesterase 4D
cards.description: Breaks down cAMP and helps end its signal.

cards.name: Protein Kinase A
cards.description: Phosphorylates targets in response to cAMP.

cards.name: Calcineurin
cards.description: Removes phosphate groups in response to calcium and calmodulin.

cards.name: β₂ Adrenergic Receptor
cards.description: Activates Gαs in response to adrenergic signals.

cards.name: mGluR1
cards.description: Couples glutamate sensing to intracellular calcium signaling.

cards.name: CaMKII
cards.description: Responds to calcium spikes and can retain activity after they pass.

cards.name: Rhodopsin
cards.description: Triggers the visual signaling cascade when its chromophore absorbs light.

cards.name: GRIN1
cards.description: Forms an essential subunit of NMDA receptors that link synaptic activity to calcium signals.
